_instructions: Copy the 'scripts' section below into your package.json, replacing the existing scripts section entirely.

_script_explanations.dev: Starts the Next.js development server at http://localhost:3000 with hot reload
_script_explanations.build: Compiles the app for production deployment
_script_explanations.lint: Checks your code for errors using ESLint
_script_explanations.prisma:generate: Regenerates the Prisma client after schema changes
_script_explanations.prisma:migrate: Applies schema changes to the database (creates/alters tables)
_script_explanations.prisma:studio: Opens a visual database browser at http://localhost:5555
_script_explanations.prisma:reset: WARNING: Deletes all data and rebuilds tables from scratch
_script_explanations.workers:start: Starts all background workers (crawlers, email agent, application engine)
